scope: Native constant append binding, literal lifetime, owned loop persistence and helper failure propagation
reproduction: After successful native compilation repeated(7) returned 7 instead of 7abababab; VM/interpreter agreed on the expected value.
implementation: Append mutates the current callee SSA root or named binding, never the caller physical slot. Loop paths use their own bindings.
Retain constant string allocations through compiled-code lifetime. Preserve COW snapshots and current-scope mutation checks.
Load and persist owned loop locals through the tagged codec and paired SSA kind. Named assignment targets stay in maps to avoid premature undefined reads; named stores preserve owned values.
Install runtime-error checks for standard/loop/script helper results as well as direct-argument functions. Append type failures are catchable in the VM and skip later effects.

verification.cost: 1000 character appends reuse preallocated unique storage; aliased snapshots remain unchanged. Compiled 8/128-append cases retain at most four root slots of vector capacity, zero live roots after return, and no VM stack residue.
cases: Callee/caller isolation, saved snapshots, repeated loops and dictionary-to-string local type changes
Dropped source-chunk literal lifetime and compiler-drop release
Owned loop writeback and named assignment
Undefined reads stop before later named assignments
Hot append/operator errors skip later effects and recover on subsequent valid calls
